feature: Native recruit Scouting letter grades and grade ranges
status: Stage 2 prototype complete; revealed values, partial ranges, hidden values, another position and Back verified live

prototype.loading: Separate session-only DLL alongside the unchanged installed Social Media v103 runtime
prototype.buildNote: Choose an unused numeric pNN suffix. Existing DLL filenames are refused because loaded prototypes are pinned.
prototype.recovery: Stop restores only the owned recruiting getter slot. Reopen recruiting to request a fresh unmodified native response. A game restart unloads the session-only prototype.

visibility.revealed: Convert the already-displayed integer value to one letter
visibility.partial: Convert the already-displayed lower/upper bounds to a range, e.g. C–B; collapse to one letter when both bounds share a grade
visibility.rangePrecision: Fractional bounds are conservatively rounded outward; no hidden true rating is consulted
visibility.nativeUnknown: Leave HaveSlider=false, SliderStart=0 untouched below 100% scouting, preserving native incognito behavior
visibility.invalidValues: Malformed ratings/bounds become ?; unrecognized response structures are left untouched and counted
visibility.fullyScoutedZero: A genuinely revealed zero at 100% scouting becomes F

integration.guards: Getter and both UI setter prologues must match 32-byte fingerprints; vtable slot must still point to the verified original getter
integration.response: Native UI Variant array of recruit maps, with ScoutingAttributes maps
integration.dataflow: Native Scouting model copies SliderStart directly into AttributeButton.ExtraInfo.Points. String labels plus a false HaveSlider flag use the existing mcPoints.SetLabel branch instead of the numeric bar.
integration.flagRepresentation: The native flag setter creates numeric 0/1 UI values; the script tests their truth value. It is not a direct boolean-memory write.
integration.ownership: Original getter called exactly once; its result and output pointer preserved. Native UI setters handle string storage and reference ownership.
integration.backgroundWork: No player/database polling or archive scanning. Conversion runs only when the game naturally requests the recruit list. A bounded diagnostic queue flushes separately.
integration.nativeUnknownZeroHandling: Scouted is already true for a partially scouted recruit, so the native PercentageScouted value, not Scouted alone, distinguishes full completion.

unchanged: Player/Recruit database ratings and simulation data
Scouting progress, hours, costs and action availability
Abilities, mentals and development trait visibility
Save files and installed MMC plugins

localChecks.hiddenRatingIndependence: Changing the hidden-value argument does not change range output

localChecks.bytecodeEvidenceLimit: The extraction tool now reports unsupported nested instructions separately from top-level decode exceptions. There are 62 unsupported instructions across 53 assets. The specific attribute-copy fragment and AttributeButton.Draw branch were independently inspected.

liveChecks.timing: Captured conversions report 0 ms on GetTickCount64. This is a coarse timer, not proof of sub-millisecond latency.
